name: prestashopheaven/runtime-cqrs
description: The command bus of a PrestaHaven module: passes each command or query to its handler from the Symfony container, and gives hooks and legacy controllers safe access to it.

prestashopheaven.use-when: A module dispatches commands and queries (DDD + CQRS, ARCH-08), or a hook, widget or legacy controller needs the command bus or another service of the module without breaking the page when the container is stale.
